units: Ḥull. 50ᵃ מע׳ לע׳ between one groove (of a lobe of the lungs) and another.—Esp. (cmp. עוּגְיְתָא) garden bed.
<cite ref="Shabbat 85a:4">Ib. 85ᵃ</cite> <he>ע׳ בחורבה שנינו</he> the Mishnah speaks of a garden bed in a fallow field (isolated bed); a. fr.—Pl. <he>עֲרוּגוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 85b:4">Ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>ערוגה בין הע׳ שנינו</he> the Mishnah speaks of a bed among other beds.
<cite ref="Tosefta Kilaim 2:5">Tosef. Kil. II, 5</cite> <he>ע׳ קטנות</he> (some ed. <he>ערוגיות</he>, <cite ref="P01292"><he>ערגיות</he></cite>, corr. acc., or <he>עוּגְיוֹת</he>); a. fr.
